Priya (AE): Hey team — BrightLeaf legal sent back an MSA with a few redlines. Main asks: EU data residency language, 99.9% SLA with credits, termination for convenience, and KMS/encryption specifics. They attached an order form and want DocuSign routing. Procurement wants countersign by Fri EOD. @Tom (Legal) can you take first pass?

Tom (Legal): On it. Please upload their redline vs our baseline. Quick flags: 99.9% SLA + financial penalties — we should push for service credits only and a liability cap tied to fees. Also need clarification on the KMS requirement (customer-managed keys vs our KMS). @Daniel (Eng) can you confirm feasibility for EU-only keys?

Sasha (AM): Procurement also asked for billing contact and W-9/tax docs. I already sent the vendor onboarding link: https://redwood.example.com/vendor-onboard. They said their procurement timeline is tight (usually ~10 days). Will follow up with them tomorrow. :calendar:

Daniel (Eng): EU-only key management is feasible but requires Private deployment + customer KMS integration or dedicated VPC. POC-wise we can do a sandbox with tenant-specific keys; full production will need an SOW for networking and KMS work. I can draft a short connectivity appendix and KMS options by Thu.

Priya (AE): Pricing question from the buyer: can we offer a committed monthly GPU-hour block with a 20% discount and list overage pricing? They want that on the order form. Also they asked about SLA credits formula.

Tom (Legal): For SLA credits propose: service credits up to a % of monthly fees, not a dollar-for-dollar refund, and cap aggregate credits at X% of total monthly subscription. I'll draft fallback language for change-of-law and force majeure. Need to see their redline to pick specific language.

Priya (AE): Order form snapshot I pasted to them:
```
Product: Redwood Dedicated - 4x A100
Commit: 12 months
Monthly fee: $32,500
Overage rate: $150/hr
Support: Standard enterprise (SLA 99.9%)
```
Can someone confirm these numbers or suggest edits?

Sasha (AM): Numbers look reasonable but I'll confirm with finance; billing contact is finance@redwood.com. Also I'll attach our standard tax docs.

E-Sign Bot: DocuSign envelope sent to legal@brightleaf.com. Envelope ID: 0a1b2c3d. Status: Sent.

Tom (Legal): FYI — once we upload our counter I want signature routing to go: Redwood sign -> BrightLeaf legal -> BrightLeaf CFO. Can we set that in DocuSign?

Priya (AE): Customer procurement said they need MSA + DPA + order form fully executed before they issue a PO. Targeting countersign by Fri. I'll coordinate daily with procurement. @Sasha can you own vendor setup?

Daniel (Eng): For the POC access I'll spin up a sandbox key with rate limits and prefix caching disabled. Recommend sending a short runbook for network peering steps so they can test connectivity. I'll post the runbook draft here when ready.

Sasha (AM): Will add signature-routing and vendor-setup tasks to the deal board, and set a Fri EOD reminder. I'll also confirm payment terms (Net30 vs Net45) with finance and update order form. :white_check_mark:

Priya (AE): Thanks all — next actions: @Tom upload legal counter by tomorrow, @Daniel upload KMS/connectivity appendix by Thu, @Sasha confirm billing/tax and set up DocuSign routing. I'll keep buyer updated and push for Friday.

(attach: brightleaf_msa_redline_v2.pdf)
